newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in Nov 18 week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in Nov 18 week.

text.p: Russian inflation slowed in the week ended November 18 to 0.4 percent from 0.6 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
Inflation in the first 18 days of November was 1.2 percent, compared with 1.2 percent in the whole of October.
If current trends continued, inflation for the whole of November would be 2.0 percent, the committee said. This would be the highest monthly rate since April's 2.2 percent.
At current rates, inflation for the year could be 22 percent, compared with year-on-year inflation of 131 percent in December 1995.
